market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a well-established mid-table Premier League side with no looming points deductions, financial crises, or mass player exodus. Historically, similar clubs are relegated less than 15% of the time in a given season; the market's 34.5% implied chance is far above that baseline, presenting a strong mispricing.
evidence_points: West Ham have been continuously in the Premier League since 2012-13, finishing between 6th and 16th, and are currently safe in 2024-25.
Squad quality (Bowen, Paqueta, Kudus) and financial strength significantly exceed typical relegation candidates.
No credible reports of points deductions, embargoes, or administrative chaos that would raise relegation risk to 34.5%.
